description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointArnMiddleware class within the Aws\S3Control namespace. The class provides middleware functionality to handle and process Amazon S3 Access Point ARNs in commands, allowing for ARN parsing, validation, and endpoint modification based on ARN data. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for S3 Control operations.

classes.name: EndpointArnMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling ARNs targeting S3 access points in commands, including ARN parsing, validation, and endpoint URL modifications based on ARN details.
